en: Color postcard showing a panoramic view of a central square in a historic European city. In the foreground is a large paved square with a column-like monument. On the right stands a distinctive historic building with a large blue-green dome – a former mosque – surrounded by a curved street lined with parked cars from the late 20th century. On the left is a long Baroque-style building with a red-tiled roof, and in the distance a cathedral with four tall towers is visible above the rooftops. The lower border of the card bears the word "PÉCS" in large serif letters. The reverse side is a standard unused postcard layout with address lines, stamp boxes and publisher information.
